notes.title: Pre-Release Patch Notes: v0.54
notes.content:
NEWLY ADDED[p align="start"]

DUNGEON

Hand crafted new cave dungeon tiles with custom props and vegetation per each tile.

New cave / dungeon look & overhaul on height / space.

New cave / dungeon lighting and VFX.

Glow Particles

Smoke

Rays

other smaller particles

Added Roofs to all dungeon / cave tiles & fixed door glitches with improper placeholder assets.

Created new boss tile for the dungeon as well as more variation in overall tile size.



PLAYER & COMBAT

Overhaul on combat system and combat flow.

New Combo system with combat, unique combo's will increase damage!

New XP system when gathering resources or fighting enemies.

Updated notification system for the player.

Updated Quest tracking system for the player.

Re-Worked animation transition & smoothing for combat animations when moving and while still.



ENEMIES

Added new enemy "Spirit Warrior"

Added the first Nightmare Boss "The Pantheon" ( Still WIP )

Re-Introduced enemy "Serpent"



DREAM LAND

Re-Touched foliage and tree LOD optimization.

More mountain range sculpting & painting. 

Altered NPC walk paths & re-baked navigation meshes.

Testing dialog options & dialog / quest system with NPC's

Added more VFX and particles to the dream land.

Added more animals to the dream land

[p align="start"]

ETC

Added more buildings and updated exteriors.

Other small bug fixes.

notes.title: Pre-Release Patch Notes: v0.51
notes.content:
GAME UPDATES


PLAYER

Added player customization for skin color, hair, eyes, beard & mustache / facial hair.

More categories and items per category coming soon.
[p align="start"]All elemental enchantments are now visual on the weapon and scale with the item level.

This needs to be tweaked a little considering a high level fire sword is now essentially a flame thrower. ( while still cool, it needs slight balance. )

Added punching animations for when no weapons are equipped.

Added / improved on the 2 handed weapon animations and planning out for adding magic / spell animations.

Added Resource Gathering animations for mining, etc.

Updated player inventory weight capacity and total inventory slots.

Updated player starting currency amount.



VENDORS & ACTIONS

Added new 'Shady Vendor' with unique shop items to help enchant weapons and gear.

Rearranged blacksmith shop items & adjusted all item prices.

Added items to Resource Shop vendor near the farm to help get started on gathering resources.

Updated Crafting table system & fixed thumbnail bugs with specific crafts.

Added dynamic IK to all vendors and NPC's to look at the player when within specific range while not messing up their idle and talk animations. ( This was added to give NPC's a little more life and feel a tad more realistic. )

Added base framework for resource gathering (Mining rocks / minerals, gathering plants, etc)



CAMERA

Created a new 'Free-Cam' script with lots more smoothing and speed controls

Portals now have camera's that export to a render texture so the player can visible see in real time what is on the other side of the portal.

Small updates to player Camera Follow script

Base camera settings updated for max view distance and some other small changes.



Check Out Our Patch Notes Review Video!

Other animals coming soon!

Working on adding in dynamic enemy movement based on enemy type and other fun combat mechanics & depth!
